scope: initial measured improvement on authored family-disjoint English evaluation, not production or coding savings
train_sources: families.json train; all viewed earlier final tests are development training
selection: Mean validation classification error plus alternative-order winner flip rate plus 0.1 times order JS; all six orders; both seeds frozen before final check
failure_policy: Do not lower criteria; a viewed test becomes development data, require a new family holdout for a new cycle. Preserve all failures.
calibration_policy: Same untouched 24 calibration cases from PDCA-04; same grid for baseline and tuned.
final_policy: Reuse PDCA-04 final/calibration only because no final inference occurred in that aborted validation-only run. No viewed test is re-sealed.
